comment: Machine-readable Tier-1 core inventory. Single source of truth: SPEC.md prose and tools/spec_check.py both derive from this file. Indices and check bits are normative (the register rule and digit assignments depend on them).

content.notes: licensed realizations [tʃ]~[ts] (affricate standard); [ʃ] is attested L1 drift, not licensed — keeps t+i vs c+i distinct under palatalization

particle.notes: reserved for particles; canonical realizations [h]~[x]~[ʔ] — never bare resyllabification (see SPEC §2.1, §5.2)

registers.realization: long vowel, target duration >= 1.5x short in careful speech; romanized by doubling (optional, derivable)

register_rule.lexical_side: syllables satisfying the rule; the only side words may use
register_rule.complement_side: anti-check syllables; reserved for mode payloads
register_rule.what_it_detects: register-channel noise trivially, plus every single-channel substitution between two values with different check bits; check bits are assigned to cover the perceptually likely confusions (see covered_confusion_pairs)
register_rule.what_it_does_not_detect: substitutions between same-check-bit values (see residual_confusion_pairs); those are the lexicon generator's responsibility via pairwise spacing
register_rule.note: an earlier draft used index parity and claimed uniform Hamming distance 2; that claim was wrong (same-parity substitutions were invisible) and the uniform-distance-2 alternative caps the space at 20 codewords (mod-10 check over the largest channel), which is why coverage is confusion-weighted instead

covered_confusion_pairs.comment: high-likelihood same-channel confusions that MUST have different check bits; spec_check.py asserts each

residual_confusion_pairs.comment: same-check-bit pairs the register cannot catch; the lexicon generator must enforce spacing between words differing only in one of these

particle.namespace_width: PROVISIONAL until conlang-jbw enumerates the structural inventory — not part of the freeze candidate

content.stress: first syllable, realized as pitch/intensity (never duration)
content.pos_coda: final syllable coda encodes part of speech

digit_units_rimes.comment: units digit -> rime; 0-4 = bare vowel (coda index 0), 5-9 = vowel + coda n (coda index 1)

spacing_rules_v01: register-only contrast: impossible by construction (register is computed)

residual-pair rule: no two UNRELATED lexical words may differ by a single residual_confusion_pairs substitution (generator-enforced); same-root POS alternations are exempt — verb/modifier coda n/s pairs are morphology, and a misheard class is caught by syntax or recovered semantically
echo-vowel rule (all positions): a coda s/l and the same consonant plus an echo vowel may not both occur where they could be confused — /...Cs/ vs /...Csu/ and medial equivalents
fake-geminate rule: a coda consonant followed by an identical onset may not contrast with the single-consonant parse (/nas.sa/ vs /na.sa/)

glide-cell rule: syllables ji and wu are not lexical (the glide onset perceptually fuses with the homorganic vowel, producing an apparently onset-less syllable that would misparse as a particle); jV/wV cells with near-homorganic vowels (je, wo) carry extra weighting
coronal-i rule: no t/c or s/c lexical minimal pairs before vowel i (ti->[tʃi], si->[ɕi] palatalization for several major L1s lands inside c's space)

anti-resyllabification (tosmabru-class): for any lexical word ending in a consonant coda followed by any particle, the resyllabified surface string may not parse as a legal word sequence — generator-enforced over the actual lexicon and particle inventory

confusion_policy.comment: two-tier pricing of the check-invisible (residual) pairs; forbidden+weighted must exactly partition residual_confusion_pairs (spec_check asserts). Forbidden = true confusables the check bit missed; weighted = same-bit but perceptually distinct, allowed as minimal pairs at a scored cost, avoided among high-frequency assignments.

lexical_cell_rules.comment: structured lexicon-rule data (SPEC 4.3); tools load these — nothing phonological is hardcoded in code
lexical_cell_rules.echo_vowels_note: epenthetic vowel qualities attested in the target L1s: Japanese [ɯ]->u and [o] after coronal stops, Korean [i] after palatals

capacity_expected.comment: exact outputs of tools/lexgen.py capacity_report; spec_check asserts these so SPEC/paper prose cannot drift from the computed truth
